messages:
alex: Heads-up — saw OTLP trace ingest spike from prod routes over the last 30m, tracing writes ~4x baseline. Thinking we should prototype a dynamic sampling policy at the collector layer: small global head-sample + tail-sampling on errors/high-latency, with route/customer-tier overrides. Anyone on board with doing this in the collector vs at the gateway/SDK?

ops-telemetry: alert: trace-ingest-rate-limit triggered for org:acme (rule: high-ingest). Dropping non-sampled spans currently.

maria: +1 to collector-level for fast rollout, but we need a way to surface sampling rates in the Console so SREs + customers can debug missing traces.

ben: collector is easier for ops, but we lose per-request context if SDK doesn't attach route/tier tags. Can we ensure the gateway adds route=ticket-checkout and tier=premium before the collector sampler?

sam: Agree with ben. Small SDK tag or gateway header solves that. Also want to keep sampling config as code — probably in our otel-collector config or a configmap the collector reads.

alex: Updated idea: gateway adds `x-rw-route` and `x-rw-tier`, collector uses those attributes in the tail_sampler. Default head_sample: 5% global, tail_sampler: sample 100% of error spans, and route overrides for a handful of high-value routes. Prototype config snippet:

```yaml
processors:
  tail_sampler:
    decision_wait: 30s
    policies:
      - name: error-policy
        type: latencies
        threshold: 500ms
        sample_rate: 1.0
      - name: high-value-route
        attribute: attributes["x-rw-route"]
        match_value: "checkout"
        sample_rate: 0.5
service:
  pipelines: ...
```

irene: That looks reasonable. A couple of caveats: tail_sampler needs memory for trace windows — at our scale we should bound the buffer or fall back to head decisions. Also decision_wait latency adds visibility delay; make sure it doesn't break our SLO alerts that rely on near-real-time traces.

maria: For Console UX: we should expose effective sampling rate per route and per org for the last 24h, and an audit log for sampling config changes. That will help SEs when customers complain "where did our traces go".

ben: Also add sampling budget per org. If a customer is on a free tier we can apply stricter head sampling but keep tail-sampling for errors. That gives predictable billing while preserving signal.

sam: Implementation questions: do we tag sampled traces with `sampling.reason` (e.g., "error", "route_override", "head") so the Console and debug tools can filter? Seems useful.

alex: Yes — let's standardize `sampling.reason` and `sampling.policy_id`. Console can show counts broken down by reason. Also plan: collector exports both sampled traces and a small telemetry metric about dropped traces so we can build a dashboard.

ops-telemetry: FYI — exporter backpressure observed when tail_sampler buffer is high. We should add a hard cap and a fallback path (increase head_sample temporarily).

irene: Operational plan: 1) Gateway adds route+tier headers (low-risk), 2) Deploy collector prototype in staging with the tail_sampler policies and bounded buffer, 3) Add metrics: `rw_sampling_effective_rate{route,org,tier,reason}`, 4) Console widgets for effective rate + audit.

maria: UX for rollouts: rollout in 3 steps — staging -> canary (5% of traffic) -> global. Console rollout card should show expected token savings estimate and error-trace retention impact.

ben: Curious about retention/backfill: if we aggressively sample, our evals might lose sample coverage. Suggest we pin a tiny permanent sample for eval routes (e.g., 0.1%) or fanout special eval spans to a separate exporter.

alex: Good call. Action items: @ben add gateway header PR, @sam prototype otel-collector config and memory bounds, @maria Wireframe Console widgets, @irene run staging load test. I'll coordinate canary once we have metrics.

maria: Thanks — I'll add a quick mock in Figma and a list of dashboard queries.

ben: I'll start the gateway change in a branch and add tests to ensure headers propagate across retries.

sam: Will push a collector config in a draft PR with test harness.

ops-telemetry: Noted. I'll watch the staging cluster and add alerts for tail_sampler drops.

alex: Cool. If we hit edge cases (collector memory or exporter congestion) we'll fallback to a temporary head-sample bump and notify the rollout card.

irene: One more: include per-org opt-out flag for privacy-sensitive customers (Private deployments). Collector should respect a `x-rw-sampling-control: inherit|force-head|force-sample` header.

alex: Perfect. We'll document header semantics in the API docs and the rollout checklist.

maria: ok, moving to async — will send the mock + queries later today.

ben: Thanks all :thumbsup:
